environment_setting: Country B, City X, where citizens are known for their active participation in social and political activities, sometimes leading to disturbances in public and private institutions
norm_base: Citizens Disturbing order of government agencies, organizations, enterprises, causing work, production, business, medical care, teaching, research unable to proceed normally Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: organizing a peaceful rally with proper permits
legitimate.benefits: raises awareness for social issues, gains public support
legitimate.costs: requires time and effort to obtain permits and organize

illegal.illegal_action: organizing an unauthorized protest that disrupts government office operations
illegal.benefits: gains immediate attention and media coverage
illegal.costs: warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.benefits: ensures public order, avoids personal liability

illegal.costs: if discovered, may face disciplinary action or fine

legitimate.legitimate_action: cooperating with authorities to manage protest impact
legitimate.benefits: minimizes disruption to business, maintains good relations with authorities
legitimate.costs: may require additional resources and time

illegal.illegal_action: taking no action against the protest
illegal.benefits: saves resources and avoids immediate conflict
illegal.costs: if protest escalates, business operations may be severely disrupted, potential fines
